description: Merge requests, review discussions, pipelines, issues and publishing for GitLab.com and self-managed GitLab. Inactive until you sign in.

gitlab.serverUrl.description: The GitLab server: https://gitlab.com, or a self-managed GitLab's address.

gitlab.oauthClientId.description: The application id of the OAuth application used to sign in with a device code (GitLab 17.2 or later). The default is Codalus IDE's application on gitlab.com; a self-managed GitLab needs its own. Empty: sign in with a personal access token.
